share-explanation: When this is on, each milestone you add (secondary, interview invite, waitlist, rejection, acceptance, withdrawn, hold) is shared as one anonymous event: the school, the program, the type and the day. The public pages never link it to you. Your submission and completion dates and your home state are never shared, and a public figure appears only when at least 3 people reported the same thing on the same day. Public figures update once a day. Turn it off, or delete the milestone, and the event is removed at once; the public totals follow at the next daily update.
share-too-new: Sharing needs an account at least {{days}} days old. You can turn it on once yours is.
